purpose: Preparation and deployability demonstrated by evidence; not intrinsic source quality.

criterion_points.1: Partial/subset/older-revision evidence; may include failed gates.
criterion_points.2: Complete applicable criterion verified for the assessed scope/revision.

rubric.global_calculation: Independent sum of five global criterion scores. Category rows overlap and must not be averaged.
rubric.registry_adaptation: For account rows, gates cover authentication/permissions, artifacts cover registry/target state, runtime covers automation. Registry readiness is separate from private source deployment.
rubric.unknowns: Zero demonstrated points is not proof that an account or capability does not exist.
